displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists Segment anything in the Detection Segmentation area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Segment anything”. The page names Alexander Kirillov, Eric Mintun, Nikhila Ravi, Hanzi Mao, Piotr Dollar, Ross Girshick as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
